d:
Build strength, improve mobility, and recover better with this 30 min yoga for athletes class designed to help reduce stiffness, increase flexibility, and support full body recovery.
This yoga practice is great for runners, surfers, lifters, cyclists, climbers, and anyone with an active lifestyle looking to improve mobility, release tight muscles, and move with more ease. If you’re feeling sore from training, workouts, or sports, this session can help improve circulation, reduce tension, and support faster recovery.
